summary: Drift-proof install-docs contract for Home Assistant app/add-on repos. Home Assistant renames its UI roughly every 6 months; hardcoded nav paths in READMEs rot. This lints for the durable pattern (My Home Assistant redirect badges) and against known-stale wording.

scope.markdown_aware_rationale: Match rendered prose, not raw markdown source. Skip fenced/inline code and markdown link/image URL targets so badge URLs and code blocks never false-positive. Measured: naive substring matching = ~45% false-positive on real repos; markdown-aware = ~0%.

banned_phrases.message: Stale nav label 'Add-on Store' — Home Assistant renamed it to 'App store'.
banned_phrases.fix_hint: Use a My Home Assistant redirect badge (supervisor_store), or the current 'App store' wording.

banned_phrases.message: Stale nav path 'Settings > Add-ons' — Home Assistant renamed it to 'Settings > Apps'.
banned_phrases.fix_hint: Use a My Home Assistant redirect badge, or 'Settings > Apps'.

install_badge.pattern_note: Host-anchored, with a capture group for the slug. The linter accepts the badge only when the captured slug is in redirect_slugs.known_good and the link is not inside code — a code-fenced, commented-out, or dead-slug badge does not satisfy the rule.
install_badge.message: Install docs must include a My Home Assistant redirect badge/link with a known-good slug. Redirect links are drift-proof: Home Assistant keeps them pointing at the right page across UI renames.
install_badge.fix_hint: Add a redirect badge, e.g. https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/supervisor_store/ . See redirect_slugs for valid slugs.

fallback_required.supervisor_add_addon_repository: Broken end-to-end (my.home-assistant.io#698, open since 2026-04): the redirect drops the repository URL. Write the add-repository step as plain text (canonical); badge optional until fixed.
fallback_required.hacs_generic: No generic HACS store slug exists (only hacs_repository, for one named repo). Write generic 'install via HACS' as plain text.

addon.note: Home Assistant add-on repo: redirect badge for the store; NOT required to document HACS.

hacs-integration.note: HACS custom integration: must document the HACS install step (marker <!-- contract:install-hacs -->).

hacs-frontend.note: HACS frontend/dashboard card: same HACS install requirement.

error_format.rationale: Uniform with the commit-standards error_format so agents get deterministic, greppable output.
